articles.summary: NEW BRAUNFELS, Texas, Oct. 19, 2023 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — TaskUs, Inc. (Nasdaq: TASK), a leading provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to the world’s most innovative companies, today announced Frontiers in Psychiatry has published the first peer-reviewed study that evaluates a robust employee screening tool, The Cognitive Adaptability and Resiliency Employment Screener […]
articles.title: TaskUs Announces Frontiers in Psychiatry Publishes First Peer-Reviewed Research Study Investigating Trait-Based, Pre-Hire Screening for Content Moderators
